All demos in reverse chronological order

I wanted one plain, chronological list of everything on this site, newest first. The home page groups experiments by topic so related tests sit together, while this archive sorts every experiment, guide and benchmark by the date it was added.

How it works

Every experiment directory holds a small page.json file with an added field in YYYY-MM-DD format alongside its title, summary, tags and topic group. When npm run build collects those manifests into /shared/pages.js and writes the RSS feed, this page reads that same manifest client-side with zero extra network requests and zero canvases.
